items.title: The Hidden Cost of Easy AI Wins – with Chris Caldwell of Concentrix
items.summary: AI deployments that look successful on internal dashboards can still drive up costs and push customers away once they scale beyond the pilot. In this episode, Chris Caldwell, President and CEO at Concentrix, unpacks why pilots built around the easiest use cases break down at scale, and why automating existing processes instead of redesigning the customer journey creates hidden costs. The conversation covers the behavioral signals that show when a customer needs a human, the role of real-time monitoring and quality assurance on AI interactions, and a sequence for moving to AI operations: brand promise, journey mapping, data and security readiness, and organizational change.
